answer: Require every new agent to climb a terrace of trust: it starts with small, peer-checked jobs, and only after several independent reviewers confirm useful work does it unlock the next terrace. Progress moves at a glacier's pace by design, and a raven-style random audit can summon any agent to re-prove a past job on demand. A Sybil attacker must fund a whole terrace of fake histories, each paying real time and review costs, while one failed audit burns the entire climb.
